entries.title: Luke 15:1
segments: ¶Then all the tax collectors and the sinners drew near to Him to hear Him.

entries.title: Luke 15:2
segments: And the Pharisees and scribes complained, saying, "This Man receives sinners and eats with them."

entries.title: Luke 15:3
segments: So He spoke this parable to them, saying:

entries.title: Luke 15:4
segments: "What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if he loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one which is lost until he finds it?

entries.title: Luke 15:5
segments: "And when he has found [it], he lays [it] on his shoulders, rejoicing.

entries.title: Luke 15:6
segments: "And when he comes home, he calls together [his] friends and neighbors, saying to them, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!'

entries.title: Luke 15:7
segments: "I say to you that likewise there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine just persons who need no repentance.

entries.title: Luke 15:8
segments: "Or what woman, having ten silver coins, if she loses one coin, does not light a lamp, sweep the house, and search carefully until she finds [it]?

entries.title: Luke 15:9
segments: "And when she has found [it], she calls [her] friends and neighbors together, saying, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found the piece which I lost!'

entries.title: Luke 15:10
segments: "Likewise, I say to you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents."

entries.title: Luke 15:11
segments: ¶Then He said: "A certain man had two sons.

entries.title: Luke 15:12
segments: "And the younger of them said to [his] father, 'Father, give me the portion of goods that falls [to me].' So he divided to them [his] livelihood.

entries.title: Luke 15:13
segments: "And not many days after, the younger son gathered all together, journeyed to a far country, and there wasted his possessions with prodigal living.

entries.title: Luke 15:14
segments: "But when he had spent all, there arose a severe famine in that land, and he began to be in want.

entries.title: Luke 15:15
segments: "Then he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

entries.title: Luke 15:16
segments: "And he would gladly have filled his stomach with the pods that the swine ate, and no one gave him [anything].

entries.title: Luke 15:17
segments: "But when he came to himself, he said, 'How many of my father's hired servants have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

entries.title: Luke 15:18
segments: 'I will arise and go to my father, and will say to him, "Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you,

entries.title: Luke 15:19
segments: "and I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants."'

entries.title: Luke 15:20
segments: "And he arose and came to his father. But when he was still a great way off, his father saw him and had compassion, and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.

entries.title: Luke 15:21
segments: "And the son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight, and am no longer worthy to be called your son.'

entries.title: Luke 15:22
segments: "But the father said to his servants, 'Bring out the best robe and put [it] on him, and put a ring on his hand and sandals on [his] feet.

entries.title: Luke 15:23
segments: 'And bring the fatted calf here and kill [it], and let us eat and be merry;

entries.title: Luke 15:24
segments: 'for this my son was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.' And they began to be merry.

entries.title: Luke 15:25
segments: "Now his older son was in the field. And as he came and drew near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

entries.title: Luke 15:26
segments: "So he called one of the servants and asked what these things meant.

entries.title: Luke 15:27
segments: "And he said to him, 'Your brother has come, and because he has received him safe and sound, your father has killed the fatted calf.'

entries.title: Luke 15:28
segments: "But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and pleaded with him.

entries.title: Luke 15:29
segments: "So he answered and said to [his] father, 'Lo, these many years I have been serving you; I never transgressed your commandment at any time; and yet you never gave me a young goat, that I might make merry with my friends.

entries.title: Luke 15:30
segments: 'But as soon as this son of yours came, who has devoured your livelihood with harlots, you killed the fatted calf for him.'

entries.title: Luke 15:31
segments: "And he said to him, 'Son, you are always with me, and all that I have is yours.

entries.title: Luke 15:32
segments: 'It was right that we should make merry and be glad, for your brother was dead and is alive again, and was lost and is found.'"
